_: Small fixes to the painted sheets, applied by import-spell-art.py after its checks (docs/notes/spell-art-bde.md): `frames` packs a row's source frames (from 0) in this order.

healing-mist.ground.why: the mist grows out of nothing over the first frames; looped as painted it would vanish and swell each time round

healing-mist.motes.why: the first frame is empty, the second faint and the last breaks into sparks: the leaf would blink

mana-font.ground.why: the circle lights up from faint lines over the first frames: it would pop dark each loop

aura-rot.ground.why: the stain spreads from almost nothing over the first frames: it would blink each loop

storm-cloud.ground.why: the first three frames are almost empty (the cloud gathers); looped as painted it would blink out each time round

spirit-guardians.ground.why: the ring swaps gold and pale blue every frame, a strobe at play speed: it keeps the blue frames

keg-blast.travel.why: the frames swap between two different drawings of the keg (side and end on): it keeps the one with the fuse

quivering-palm.cast.why: the gathering light ends at its brightest: it fades out over two more frames

tentacles.cast.why: the tentacle ends risen at full: it sinks away (fades) over two more frames
